title: 📐 SPN-159 Observe completed native drawing resizes
body:
The native Doc drawing check could accept an unrelated height resize as completion of narrowing or restoring the editor. Readiness now requires the requested host/canvas/engine width and a subsequent native drawing-control refresh at that width. Original deadlines and counter assertions remain; exact pending mutation IDs are checked alongside the pending count.

**Source and complete scope.** Candidate `88b24d96a65cdb92712c94674399a86b129c57b3`; actual base `754e65317744e5ce97ede501935c6586e4875f2a`. The [original complete M specification](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/blob/754e65317744e5ce97ede501935c6586e4875f2a/docs/todo/SPN-159.md) remains intact: bounded native investigation, demonstrated correction and negatives, real insertion/selection/control refresh, pending-work safety, bounded diagnostics/privacy/cleanup, integration and all five existing Storybook variants. [Canonical decisions and evidence chronology](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/blob/88b24d96a65cdb92712c94674399a86b129c57b3/docs/implementation/SPN-159.md) retain the original failures and source identities.

The two predeclared native controls on `f0cb3d401b82762428f668557f9b44f7bdf341d3` demonstrated the boundary: [withholding Narrow](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/blob/88b24d96a65cdb92712c94674399a86b129c57b3/docs/implementation/evidence/SPN-159/controls-narrow.json) still advanced to Restore at width 1280 after unrelated resize/control increments; [withholding Restore](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/blob/88b24d96a65cdb92712c94674399a86b129c57b3/docs/implementation/evidence/SPN-159/controls-restore.json) let the entire old story pass at width 1272. A premature control event also occurred before native width caught up with the host. These controls establish this repair's causal boundary; they do not identify the unknown assertion, phase or cause of the [original SPN-120 failed validation](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/blob/4bd84e3be7645a3b18c794c966e0007e6770cc9c/docs/review-assets/spn-120-validation-47bf4aad/README.md). That archive retains extracted evidence and the original ZIP digest, not the full ZIP.

**Native result and integration.** The [first corrected native sample](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/blob/88b24d96a65cdb92712c94674399a86b129c57b3/docs/implementation/evidence/SPN-159/integrated/corrected-native.json) passed once on source `5108adb55c2de303af7146a0f24402be72430b3a`, base `7c38f7d32e6a55d8000239923113155de6a07c8c`: desktop light, 1280×900, Node 26.13.0, Chromium 156.0.8078.4, 2,484 ms, peak 780,208 KiB. Native narrowing reached 1272 at event 5, followed by controls 6; restoration reached 1280 at event 8, followed by controls 9. Later height event 10 followed final text selection/tool closure and was not counted as width acceptance. Actual image insertion, image/text focus and control refresh passed; pending count stayed 1 with exact `doc.mutation.rich-text-editing` ID, no UI-only selection operation entered the queue, and native/page/play errors and alerts were absent. This synthetic local queue remains unacknowledged; no server-save claim is made.

Current main adds nine maintenance source/test files outside this fixture's dependency closure. The native closure diff from source 5108 is empty. All **11** entries in the [source/config/build/native hash manifest](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/blob/88b24d96a65cdb92712c94674399a86b129c57b3/docs/implementation/evidence/SPN-159/integrated/source-identity.json), plus the preserved probe copy, match. The earlier native sample retains its original identity and was not repeated. The later exact-head compiler check below separately validates the combined source.

**Two independent full-outcome reviews — agent review only.** Both assessed exact `88b24d96a65cdb92712c94674399a86b129c57b3` against base 754, not merely its integration diff. Each independently inspected the original specification, all four personas, full implementation/landing diff, native evidence and closure, regression controls, diagnostics/cleanup and CI ownership. Neither used the other's score or deducted CI results.

- **A, `/root/drawing_reg_review_a`: 100/100**, rubric **35/35 scope, 25/25 correctness/data/access, 20/20 regression, 10/10 CI/operations design, 10/10 maintainability/over-complexity**. No actionable findings, unresolved blockers or remaining steps to 100. Report identity: `spn159-review-a-88b24d96.md`. Independently ran **15/15 focused tests** on this exact head: 497 ms watchdog duration, peak 276,624 KiB, no abort; receipt `spn159-review-a-unit-88b24d96.json`.
- **B, `/root/drawing_reg_review_b`: 100/100**, the same **35/25/20/10/10** rubric with every category at full marks. No actionable findings, unresolved blockers or remaining steps to 100. Report identity: `spn159-review-b-88b24d96.md`. Independently ran **15/15 focused tests** on this exact head: 420 ms, peak 185,696 KiB, no abort; receipt `spn159-review-b-unit-88b24d96.json`.

**Later exact-head local checks passed.** Root separately executed these checks on frozen 88b24 under the normal-pressure preflight, continuous memory watchdog, unchanged 2 GiB/eight-minute limits and pinned Node. The full native Go compiler used `GOMEMLIMIT=640MiB GOGC=50 GOMAXPROCS=2`, with no include-set reduction:

- Exact-title PR check against base 754: **461 ms / 186,832 KiB**.
- Backlog: **150 ms**; dependency boundary: **206 ms**; full Oxlint with denied warnings: **200 ms**.
- Changed-source Prettier: **273 ms / 192,112 KiB**.
- Full combined-source typecheck: **8,896 ms / 1,785,696 KiB**.
- Cleanup: receipt binds clean head 88b24, no owned processes and absent serial lock.

The exact receipt identities are `spn159-root-{pr,backlog,dependencies,lint,format,types,cleanup}-88b24d96.json`; no separate logs are claimed. Zero RSS in a short receipt means no sample before exit, not zero memory. These later actual executions supersede the frozen canonical record's and review A's earlier *pending local-check checkpoint*, without changing the candidate or rewriting their chronology. Review B inspected the newer receipts.

Earlier outcomes remain retained: the source-9ae unit attempt resource-aborted after **235 ms / 166,624 KiB**, before any test result; the following compiler was denied at preflight and never spawned. The pressure observation **1 at 07:54:48 UTC → 2 at 07:55:11 UTC** did not establish stability and caused no resumed workload. Earlier setup failures and build/typecheck resource aborts also remain failures. Subsequent independently authorized exact-head passes do not erase them or explain the historical SPN-120 failure.

**Personas and classification.** Operator gets a trustworthy gate and bounded first-failure diagnostics; Owner and Collaborator retain authored native work while selection and resizing stay distinct from edits; Link guest gains no authority. This is a nonvisual fixture/diagnostic change: visible markup/styles, production UI and access behavior are unchanged. Both independent reviewers agreed no separate visual approval is required. The existing 32-event bound, subscriptions/timer/editor disposal, synthetic-content privacy and probe `finally` cleanup remain. No sleep, blanket retry, raised deadline, new matrix, narrowed CI route or browser-security change was introduced.

**Hosted acceptance is pending at this publication checkpoint.** All seven current-head gates — Backlog, Pull request, Lint, Typecheck, Unit tests, Lib tests and Playwright smoke — and all five existing Storybook variants — desktop light/dark, phone light/dark and tablet — must pass before merge. Preserve actual source/base/tested-merge identities, event/plan digests, run/job/attempt results, selected-worker applicability and every failure disposition. Missing, skipped, cancelled or failed selected work is not a pass; local results and review grades waive nothing.

**Durable validation and completion reservations.** The [reserved validation record](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/blob/archive/spn-159-validation-88b24d96-20261114/docs/review-assets/spn-159-validation-88b24d96/README.md) uses tag `archive/spn-159-validation-88b24d96-20261114` and path `docs/review-assets/spn-159-validation-88b24d96`. It is **not published at this checkpoint**. After verified publication, it must retain both exact review reports, reviewer/root JSON receipts, source and hash-equivalence proof, actual hosted plan/job/gate identities and failure dispositions. Its verified terminal record supersedes the initial pending status here; an absent link or unverified archive is not acceptance. CI artifacts may supplement this record but expire.

The [reserved completion record](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/blob/archive/spn-159-completion-88b24d96-20261114/docs/review-assets/spn-159-completion-88b24d96/README.md) uses tag `archive/spn-159-completion-88b24d96-20261114` and path `docs/review-assets/spn-159-completion-88b24d96`. Publication is pending. It becomes evidence only after the actual guarded squash is verified and the final branch inventory is rechecked, unique source/evidence preserved and authorized cleanup completed. Merge and cleanup are not claimed now.

**Landing and size.** Retire only SPN-159, remove its remaining SPN-120 dependency while retaining SPN-120's own finite scope and fresh combined acceptance, append SPN-159 after completed 148/145/149/158/160, preserve next ID 161 and full-groom date 2026-11-12, and regenerate the index through the CLI. **48 files; 2,452 additions + 91 deletions = 2,543 raw changed lines; 2,486 after the configured generated-index exclusion.** The complete M outcome was not narrowed.
